info.title: adsb.lol API
info.description:
## Usage
Send a GET request to the endpoint you want; the API answers with JSON.
Send your key as `x-api-key`.

## Limits

Metered paths are counted against a quota; the free paths are not. Each
operation carries `x-quota` (`free` or `metered`) so a client can see which is
which without guessing from the path. Free: the `/0/` namespace (the map's own
helpers) and `/api/0/{my,routeset}`. Metered: `/v2/` and `/1/trace/`.

No key: **500 requests/day per IP**. A free key raises it:

- anonymous (30 days, no account): 500/day
- adhoc (free, request form): 1,000/day
- feeder (free, by feeding the network): 7,200/day, 20 GB/month, and the raw
  [re-api](https://www.adsb.lol/docs/feeders-only/re-api/)
- sponsor plans: up to 360,000/day — full table at https://www.adsb.lol/sponsor

Over quota returns `429` with a `Retry-After` header. Unkeyed traffic is
limited per IP; the daily window is a fixed 24h bucket, not midnight UTC.
Keyed traffic is limited per key on the tier's own windows.

## Feeders
By sending data to adsb.lol, you also get the
[direct readsb re-api](https://www.adsb.lol/docs/feeders-only/re-api/).

## License

The license for the API as well as all data ADSB.lol
makes public is [ODbL](https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/).

This is the same license
[OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright) uses.

get.description:
The complete stored trace for one aircraft, exactly as
[readsb](https://github.com/wiedehopf/readsb/blob/dev/README-json.md#trace-jsons)
writes it. Every point the aircraft reported for the day is returned; use
this for replay and analysis rather than for live positions. `icao_hex` is
the 24-bit ICAO address in 6 hex digits. Responds `404` when no trace was
recorded for that address.

404.description: No trace recorded for that address

get.description:
The tail of one aircraft's trace: the most recent points only, in
the same [readsb trace format](https://github.com/wiedehopf/readsb/blob/dev/README-json.md#trace-jsons)
as `/1/trace/full/{icao_hex}`. Cheaper than the full trace when you only
need the current flight. `icao_hex` is the 24-bit ICAO address in 6 hex
digits. Responds `404` when no trace was recorded for that address.

404.description: No trace recorded for that address

HTTPValidationError.description: A request was rejected before it reached the handler: a path or query parameter was missing or malformed (HTTP 422).
HTTPValidationError.title: HTTPValidationError

PlaneInstance.description: One aircraft to resolve a route for. `callsign` is what the route lookup uses; `lat`/`lng` disambiguate when a callsign is reused across flights.
PlaneInstance.title: PlaneInstance

PlaneList.description: Request body for `/api/0/routeset`: the aircraft to look up routes for.

planes.description: Aircraft to resolve. An empty or absent list resolves nothing.
planes.title: Planes

PlaneList.title: PlaneList

V2Response_AcItem.description: One aircraft. Field names follow [readsb's aircraft.json](https://github.com/wiedehopf/readsb/blob/dev/README-json.md#aircraftjson-and---json-port), which is also the format tar1090 consumes. A field is omitted or `null` when the aircraft does not report it, so clients must not assume presence beyond the required keys. Point/radius queries add `dst` and `dir`; any field may be `null` for an aircraft that does not report it.

alt_baro.description: Barometric altitude in feet, or the string `"ground"` when on the surface.
alt_baro.title: Alt Baro

baro_rate.description: Rate of change of barometric altitude, feet per minute.
baro_rate.title: Baro Rate

flight.description: Callsign or registration as 8 characters, right-padded with spaces.
flight.title: Flight

hex.description: 24-bit ICAO address, 6 hex digits. A leading `~` marks a non-ICAO address (e.g. TIS-B).
hex.title: Hex

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees. Absent until a position is known; see `lastPosition` for an older fix.
lat.title: Lat

lon.description: Longitude in decimal degrees. Absent until a position is known.
lon.title: Lon

messages.description: Mode S messages received from this aircraft.
messages.title: Messages

mlat.description: Fields derived from MLAT data, when the position was MLAT.
mlat.title: Mlat

nav_altitude_mcp.description: Selected altitude from the Mode Control Panel, feet.
nav_altitude_mcp.title: Nav Altitude Mcp

nav_heading.description: Selected heading. Not defined as true or magnetic by DO-260B; usually magnetic.
nav_heading.title: Nav Heading

nic_baro.description: Navigation Integrity Category for barometric altitude.
nic_baro.title: Nic Baro

r.description: Registration from the aircraft database, when known.
r.title: R

rssi.description: Recent average signal power in dBFS; always negative.
rssi.title: Rssi

seen.description: Seconds since the last message from this aircraft.
seen.title: Seen

seen_pos.description: Seconds since the last position update.
seen_pos.title: Seen Pos

t.description: ICAO type code from the aircraft database, when known.
t.title: T

tisb.description: Fields derived from TIS-B data, when the position came over TIS-B.
tisb.title: Tisb

track.description: True track over ground, degrees (0-359). True heading instead while on the ground.
track.title: Track

type.description: Source of the position / best message type, e.g. `adsb_icao`, `mlat`, `tisb_icao`, `mode_s`.
type.title: Type

version.description: ADS-B version reported by the aircraft.
version.title: Version

geom_rate.description: Rate of change of geometric altitude, feet per minute.
geom_rate.title: Geom Rate

dbFlags.description: Database bitfield: `1` military, `2` interesting, `4` PIA, `8` LADD.
dbFlags.title: Dbflags

oat.description: Outside air temperature, degrees C. Only calculated above mach 0.395.
oat.title: Oat

roll.description: Roll angle in degrees; negative is left.
roll.title: Roll

track_rate.description: Rate of change of track, degrees per second.
track_rate.title: Track Rate

wd.description: Wind direction in degrees, derived from track and speed.
wd.title: Wd

ws.description: Wind speed in knots, derived from track and speed.
ws.title: Ws

gpsOkBefore.description: Unix time before which the aircraft's GPS was still good; present for 15 minutes after GPS is lost or degraded.
gpsOkBefore.title: Gpsokbefore

gpsOkLat.description: Latitude of the last known GPS-good position.
gpsOkLat.title: Gpsoklat

gpsOkLon.description: Longitude of the last known GPS-good position.
gpsOkLon.title: Gpsoklon

lastPosition.description: Last known position with its age, used when `lat`/`lon` are older than 60 seconds.

rr_lat.description: Rough latitude estimated from the receiver position, only when no ADS-B or MLAT position exists.
rr_lat.title: Rr Lat

rr_lon.description: Rough longitude estimated from the receiver position.
rr_lon.title: Rr Lon

calc_track.description: True track derived rather than transmitted.
calc_track.title: Calc Track

nav_altitude_fms.description: Selected altitude from the Flight Management System, feet.
nav_altitude_fms.title: Nav Altitude Fms

dst.description: Distance from the query point in nautical miles. Only present on `/v2/point`, `/v2/lat/{lat}/lon/{lon}/dist/{radius}` and `/v2/closest` responses.
dst.title: Dst

dir.description: True direction of the aircraft from the query point, degrees. Only present on the point/radius queries, alongside `dst`.
dir.title: Dir

V2Response_AcItem.title: V2Response_AcItem

V2Response_LastPosition.description: The last known position of an aircraft whose regular `lat`/`lon` are older than 60 seconds, with the age of that fix.

nic.description: Navigation Integrity Category of this fix.
nic.title: Nic

seen_pos.description: Seconds since this position was received.
seen_pos.title: Seen Pos

V2Response_LastPosition.title: V2Response_LastPosition

V2Response_Model.description: Top-level envelope of every `/v2/*` response. `ac` holds the matching aircraft; `total` is its length, so a client can check for truncation without walking the array.

ctime.description: Server time the data was cached, in **Unix milliseconds**.
ctime.title: Ctime

now.description: Time the data was generated, in **Unix milliseconds**.
now.title: Now

V2Response_Model.title: V2Response_Model

loc.description: Path to the offending field; the first element names the source (`path`, `query`, `body`).
loc.title: Location

ctx.description: Extra context, when the check provides any.

icao.title: Icao
icao.description: 24-bit ICAO address of the aircraft, 6 lowercase hex digits.

r.title: Registration
r.description: Registration from the aircraft database, when known.

t.title: Type
t.description: ICAO type code from the aircraft database, when known.

dbFlags.title: Db Flags
dbFlags.description: Database bitfield: `1` military, `2` interesting, `4` PIA, `8` LADD.

desc.title: Description
desc.description: Long type name from the aircraft database, when known.

ownOp.title: Registered owner or operator
ownOp.description: Registered owner or operator from the aircraft database, when known.

year.title: Year
year.description: Year of manufacture from the aircraft database, when known.

version.title: ADS-B version
version.description: ADS-B version reported by the aircraft.

timestamp.title: Timestamp
timestamp.description: Unix time of the first point, in seconds. Offsets in `trace` are relative to this.

trace.title: Trace
trace.description: One entry per stored position; see access by index below.

TraceResponse.title: TraceResponse

TracePoint.description:
One trace position, stored as a positional array rather than an object.
Index: `0` seconds after `timestamp`, `1` latitude, `2` longitude,
`3` altitude in ft (or `"ground"`), `4` ground speed in kt,
`5` track in degrees (true heading when on the ground), `6` flags
bitfield (`1` position stale, `2` new leg, `4` geometric vertical rate,
`8` geometric altitude), `7` vertical rate in fpm, `8` extra aircraft
details (or `null`), `9` position source, `10` geometric altitude,
`11` geometric vertical rate, `12` indicated airspeed, `13` roll angle.
Fields from index `9` exist only in files generated in 2022 and later, so
the array length varies. Any of `3`-`13` can be `null`.
TracePoint.title: TracePoint

prefixItems.title: Track
prefixItems.description: True track over ground in degrees. True heading instead when the altitude is `"ground"`.

prefixItems.title: Flags
prefixItems.description: Bitfield: `1` position stale, `2` new leg, `4` geometric vertical rate, `8` geometric altitude.

prefixItems.title: Extra details
prefixItems.description: Aircraft object with extra fields, in the `aircraft.json` shape but without the values already given by position. `null` when absent.

QuotaExceeded.description: The caller is over its request quota for this path. The window that tripped is named in the body (per-second, per-minute, per-hour or per-day for unkeyed traffic; the key's tier windows for keyed traffic). Retry after the number of seconds in `Retry-After`.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the current window resets.
